title: Nested hide-to-recover learning with a metric-native kernel target
supersedes: Nothing. G79-FABRIC-OFFSET (E1) remains a stopped negative lane; its card is preserved in evidence/run_card_e1_fabric_offset.json.
lane_paragraph: A fault missing from a catalogue is one the catalogue's mappers did not draw. Rather than learning to recognise mapped fault pixels, simulate the discovery task: inside the visible catalogue repeatedly withhold whole 8-connected components with a 3 px context collar, recompute every catalogue-derived input from what remains, and fit a gradient-boosted regressor whose target is the official 300 m triangular kernel credit towards the withheld component. Inputs are label-independent GeoDAWN/feature-stack geophysics, multiscale edge/curvature transforms of elevation, gravity and RTP magnetics, USGS 3DEP lidar scarp morphometry, radiometrics, and the geometry of visible faults. Dots are placed greedily with 3 px Poisson spacing at a fixed budget.
hypothesis: The conditional distribution of an unmapped fault given the mapped network and terrain/geophysics differs from the marginal distribution of mapped fault pixels; a model trained on simulated discoveries ranks unmapped-fault kernel credit better than hand-built single-transform surfaces.
mechanism: Basin-and-Range normal-fault systems are multi-strand: subsidiary synthetic/antithetic strands, step-overs and along-strike continuations lie within ~0.3-3 km of mapped traces and share their strike; where they offset Quaternary surfaces they leave lidar-resolvable scarps (slope excess, 10-50 m step, crest convexity/base concavity).
named_non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shoreline/terrace risers and incised channel banks produce contour-parallel steps of similar 2-10 m scale near range fronts; roads and mine benches also create steps.
excluded_inputs: No registry raster, prior submission, SGMC map, Qfaults trace CSV, or score is an input to the surface.

fixed_parameters.target: max(1 - d/3 px, 0) towards the nested-withheld component; context catalogue pixels excluded from training rows
fixed_parameters.model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=250, learning_rate=0.08, max_leaf_nodes=63, min_samples_leaf=200, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=seed)
fixed_parameters.placement: gems79.placement.place: descending surface, Euclidean 3 px spacing, budget 37654 scaled by evaluation-region footprint area
fixed_parameters.final_map: model trained on nested hides of the full catalogue over the whole footprint; geometry from the full catalogue; 37654 binary dots off the catalogue; zeros elsewhere (all finite)

holdout.split: shared gems57.holdout.buffered_component_draw, seeds 20 and 30, buffer 3 px, boundary 12 px (identical to the E1 post-stop diagnostic, so controls are directly comparable)
holdout.training_for_holdout: leave-one-quadrant-out: for fold q the model is fitted only on nested hides of the VISIBLE catalogue in the three other quadrants; geometry inputs at prediction time come from the visible catalogue only
controls: seeded uniform surface, same allocator and budget

h33_foldfair_control: legacy D2.8 dots outside 2 px of the fold's visible catalogue (as in evidence/post_stop_diagnostic.json); contaminated/unmatched historical reference used as the 'current holdout best' bar
ablation: same learner without catalogue-geometry inputs
holdout.ci: shared paired physical 20 km spatial-cluster percentile bootstrap, 1000 draws

leakage_canary: Every input feature alone (static + geometry) on each seed and fold: held-out positives vs negatives >3 px from truth and >3 px from visible faults; symmetric AUC > 0.90 means leakage until proven otherwise and blocks promotion.
promotion_gate: candidate pooled HOLDOUT-DTI > h33_foldfair_control point estimate on BOTH seeds (current holdout best)
paired 95% CI of candidate minus uniform_control excludes 0 on both seeds
uniqueness (shared tool, dot definition budget-matched-v3): surface Spearman <= 0.90 vs every registry raster; final dots Spearman <= 0.90 and forward 3 px overlap <= 0.70 vs every registry raster
shared submission_writer validation: single band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, sample transform, all finite, [0,1], no mass outside footprint or on catalogue
experiments: X1: the lane exactly as specified above
X2/X3: reserved; only for a defect fix, never for tuning against the holdout
score_policy: Only evaluator outputs are labelled HOLDOUT-DTI (version, withheld positives, 95% CI). No projected leaderboard score is written. ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED requires a submission-page receipt.
